onboarding.welcomeDescription: SalesCore helps you manage customers, sales opportunities, teams and business performance in one place.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: See your sales performance, revenue, pipeline and key business KPIs in one place. Your numbers come from the records you create in SalesCore - not pre-loaded demo data.

crm.title: CRM
crm.description: Manage companies, contacts and leads - the customer relationships everything else in SalesCore is built on.

sales.title: Sales Pipeline
sales.description: Track deals from qualification to closed Won or Lost, and manage each deal's value, stage and owner.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Keep track of calls, meetings, follow-ups and sales tasks tied to your companies and deals.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Turn your CRM data into funnel conversion, revenue trends and team performance insights.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Filter, sort and export your business data for deeper analysis.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: A glossary of CRM and business terms - open any metric's "?" icon to jump straight to its definition.

search.title: Global Search
search.description: Quickly find companies, contacts, deals and other records. Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) anytime.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Stay informed about due tasks, new leads, and deals that were won, lost or need follow-up.

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: You can open this guide anytime to learn what each part of SalesCore does, or restart this tour.

whatIsSalesCore.title: What is SalesCore?
whatIsSalesCore.body: SalesCore is a CRM and business intelligence platform for managing customers, sales opportunities and team performance in one place.

howItWorks.title: How SalesCore works
howItWorks.body: You create companies, contacts, leads and deals as you work with customers. SalesCore turns those records into live dashboards, analytics and reports.

mainWorkflow.title: Where your numbers come from
mainWorkflow.body: Your dashboard numbers are not pre-loaded. They're calculated from the companies, deals and activities you create - as your pipeline grows, so do your KPIs.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.body: The total value of deals you have marked Won.
revenue.example: Example: Won deals of $10K, $15K and $30K give a Revenue of $55K.

pipelineValue.title: Pipeline Value
pipelineValue.body: The total value of your open (not yet won or lost) opportunities.
pipelineValue.example: Example: three open deals worth $10K, $25K and $40K give a Pipeline Value of $75K.

winRate.title: Win Rate
winRate.body: The share of closed deals you won: Won ÷ (Won + Lost). Open deals aren't counted.

avgDealSize.title: Average Deal Size
avgDealSize.body: Your total Revenue divided by the number of deals you've won.

salesTarget.title: Sales Target Achievement
salesTarget.body: Your Revenue for the current month compared against the sales target assigned to you.

companies.title: Companies
companies.body: Organizations you sell to - industry, size, country, and the deals and contacts linked to them.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.body: The people you talk to at each company, with their role, email and phone number.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: Early-stage interest that hasn't become an opportunity yet. Convert a qualified lead into a deal to track it through your pipeline.

pipeline.title: Sales Pipeline
pipeline.body: A board view of every open deal, grouped by stage, so you can see what's moving and what's stuck.

deals.title: Deals
deals.body: An individual sales opportunity - its value, stage, owner and expected close date.

stagesWonLost.title: Stages, Won & Lost
stagesWonLost.body: Deals move through stages until they're marked Won or Lost, which closes them out of the pipeline.

activities.title: Activities
activities.body: A log of calls, meetings, emails and notes tied to a company or deal.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Action items and follow-ups with a due date, priority and assignee.

kpisTrends.title: KPIs & Trends
kpisTrends.body: Funnel conversion, revenue trend and forecast, all computed from your real deal history.

teamPerformance.title: Team Performance
teamPerformance.body: Revenue, win rate and target achievement per sales rep - visible to Admins, Managers, Analysts and Viewers.

filtersExport.title: Filters, Sorting & Export
filtersExport.body: Build a custom view of your data with date ranges and filters, then export it for offline analysis.

insightsWhat.title: What insights mean
insightsWhat.body: Short, automated call-outs - like a target miss or a win-rate drop - drawn from your own KPIs, not generic advice.

insightsHow.title: How insights are calculated
insightsHow.body: Each insight compares your current metrics against a prior period or a threshold. If nothing stands out, SalesCore says so instead of inventing a trend.

roleAdmin.title: Admin
roleAdmin.body: Full access to all data, plus employee and department management.

roleManager.title: Manager
roleManager.body: Sees and manages the whole team's CRM data, targets and reports.

roleSalesRep.title: Sales Representative
roleSalesRep.body: Sees and manages only the customers, leads and deals they own - this is why a new account starts with an empty dashboard.

roleAnalyst.title: Analyst
roleAnalyst.body: Read-only access to all data, focused on analytics and reports.

globalSearch.title: Global Search
globalSearch.body: Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) to jump straight to any company, contact, deal or lead.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Alerts for due tasks, new leads, and deals that were won, lost or need follow-up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage your profile, password and workspace preferences.

intro.title: What is SalesCore?
intro.description: SalesCore is an integrated CRM, Business Intelligence and Management Information System designed to help organizations manage customers, sales operations and business performance in one place.

whatIsSalesCore.question: What is SalesCore?
whatIsSalesCore.answer: SalesCore is a CRM and management information platform that helps organizations manage customers, sales activities, opportunities and business performance in one place.

whatIsCrm.question: What is CRM?
whatIsCrm.answer: CRM stands for Customer Relationship Management. It helps businesses organize customer, contact, lead and sales information.

whatIsLead.question: What is a Lead?
whatIsLead.answer: A Lead is a potential customer who has not yet become a qualified sales opportunity.

whatIsDeal.question: What is a Deal?
whatIsDeal.answer: A Deal represents a potential sales transaction with a defined value, stage and owner.

whatIsPipeline.question: What is the Sales Pipeline?
whatIsPipeline.answer: The Sales Pipeline shows how opportunities move from Lead through Qualification, Proposal and Negotiation to Won or Lost.

whereNumbersComeFrom.question: Where do Dashboard numbers come from?
whereNumbersComeFrom.answer: Dashboard metrics are calculated from the real CRM and sales records available to you. They are never random or pre-loaded values.

whatIsRevenue.question: What is Revenue?
whatIsRevenue.answer: Revenue represents the value of closed-won sales recorded in SalesCore.

whatIsPipelineValue.question: What is Pipeline Value?
whatIsPipelineValue.answer: Pipeline Value represents the total value of currently open sales opportunities.

whatIsWinRate.question: What is Win Rate?
whatIsWinRate.answer: Win Rate represents the percentage of closed opportunities that were won.

whatIsAnalytics.question: What is Analytics?
whatIsAnalytics.answer: Analytics transforms CRM and sales data into measurable business performance information.

whatIsReports.question: What are Reports?
whatIsReports.answer: Reports let you filter, review and export operational business data.

whatIsInsights.question: What are Business Insights?
whatIsInsights.answer: Business Insights highlight meaningful patterns, changes and areas that may need management attention.

whoIsFor.question: Who is SalesCore for?
whoIsFor.answer: SalesCore is designed for sales teams, managers, analysts and organizations that want to manage sales operations and make data-driven decisions.

howSupportsManagement.question: How does SalesCore support management?
howSupportsManagement.answer: It connects operational CRM data with KPIs, analytics, reports and business insights so managers can understand performance and make informed decisions.

about.scenarioIntro: Imagine you are the sales manager of a software company, following one deal from first contact to Won.

company.title: Company
company.description: A sales rep finds a potential customer, Atlas Digital, and adds it to the CRM.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The decision-maker at Atlas Digital is added as a Contact.

lead.title: Lead
lead.description: A Lead is created to track Atlas Digital's early interest, then qualified.

opportunity.title: Opportunity
opportunity.description: The qualified Lead becomes a $25,000 Deal in the pipeline.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: A proposal is prepared and sent to Atlas Digital.

negotiation.title: Negotiation
negotiation.description: Terms and pricing are discussed and finalized.

wonLost.title: Won / Lost
wonLost.description: Atlas Digital agrees to buy - the Deal is marked Won.

analyticsStep.title: Analytics
analyticsStep.description: SalesCore updates Revenue, Pipeline, Win Rate and Average Deal Size automatically.

decisionStep.title: Decision
decisionStep.description: Management reviews Analytics, Reports and Business Insights to plan next steps.

dataChain.title: From Data to Decisions
dataChain.subtitle: This is what makes SalesCore more than a CRM.

insight.label: Insight
insight.example: "Most open opportunities are concentrated in the Negotiation stage."

decision.label: Decision
decision.example: "Management allocates additional sales resources to close these opportunities."
